messages.subject: Embed Shiny output into Web
parts:
I have a Shiny app and now I would like to get the output and somehow embed it into a post of a blog.

From my understanding of the Shiny tutorial, it's possible to implement HTML elements within a Shiny app. However, I want to go the other way around. I want to get the shiny app and place it into a post on a blog. Is this possible with Shiny?

Thanks,
Victor.
